title: WALTEUR Performance Budget
description: Performance budget per critical path. Each critical path declares its latency percentiles, throughput, concurrency, error rate, and memory ceiling. CONSTRAINT: p99 and p999 are mandatory and non-null — tail latency is a first-class budget, not an afterthought.

p50.description: Median latency budget, milliseconds. May be null if not budgeted.

p95.description: 95th-percentile latency budget, milliseconds. May be null if not budgeted.

p99.description: 99th-percentile latency budget, milliseconds. REQUIRED and non-null.

p999.description: 99.9th-percentile (tail) latency budget, milliseconds. REQUIRED and non-null.

throughput_rps.description: Sustained throughput target in requests per second.

max_concurrency.description: Maximum concurrent in-flight requests the path is budgeted to handle.

error_rate.description: Maximum acceptable error rate as a fraction in [0,1].

rss_mb.description: Resident-set-size memory ceiling for the path, megabytes.
